name: ExamPreparation

custom.system_prompt: You are generating educational conversations where users want to expand their knowledge and learn new things.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Quiet study room with papers and books

initial_prompt: Create an education and learning conversation with alternating turns where users collaborate to understand new material, plan their learning process, and improve study strategies.

variations.context: Planning an efficient study strategy for an upcoming exam

setting.relationship_dynamic: Classmates supporting each other under time pressure
setting.background: The exam is approaching quickly and they feel unprepared

scenario_template.topic: Realizing how little time is left before the exam
scenario_template.note: They acknowledge the need for a realistic plan

scenario_template.topic: Too much material and no clear prioritization
scenario_template.note: They compare their current study habits

scenario_template.topic: Asking how to identify high-impact topics and plan sessions
scenario_template.note: They describe the syllabus and time constraints

scenario_template.topic: Receiving a structured short-term study plan
scenario_template.note: Assistant introduces prioritization and active recall

scenario_template.topic: Adapting the plan to their personal schedules
How to stay consistent and avoid burnout
scenario_template.note: Assistant suggests breaks and progress tracking
They define the first study session

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Learner who is curious and motivated but often feels overwhelmed by the amount of information and unsure how to structure their learning effectively

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Learner who prefers structured and methodical approaches, frequently asking for clarification and validation to ensure deep understanding

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Educational learning assistant who explains concepts clearly, adapts to different learning styles, suggests effective study techniques, and helps users plan, reflect, and stay engaged
